title: Release Conservatory Runpad — 24hr Stabilization Log & Compact Checklist
content:
Context / goal:
This is a compact runpad for the Jun release (codename: conservatory). Primary goal: move traffic to v2 routing with staged canary while preserving 99th percentile latency SLO and keeping per-token unit cost within projection. Use this doc as the single-source quick checklist + 24h stabilization log for on-call and release stewards.

Summary of change:
- Routing layer change: traffic-aware fallback to quantized-compat model when Dedicated pool is saturated.
- Small model upgrade: model-v2 (attention perf patches + kv-cache improvement).
- Operator-visible flags: route.weight, batch.max_tokens and cache.prefetch.

Quick runpad (hour-by-hour highlights)
- T-2h: final preflight (smoke tests, bench against staging, notify CS + infra-watch). Check: smoke/generate endpoint, embeddings sample, auth tokens.
- T-1h: apply route.weight=0.05 for cohort A (10 hosts), open watch channels (#release-conservatory and #sre-nightwatch).
- T+0m: increase cohort A -> 5% global traffic for 15m, verify success criteria (p95 latency <= 180ms, error rate <0.2%).
- T+15m: cohort A -> 20% if green, else abort and revert to previous route config.
- T+45m: cohort B rollout ramp (20% -> 50% over 30m) with telemetry sampling increased.
- T+90m: full ramp to 100% if all gates pass. Begin 24h stabilization log.

Preflight checklist (must be green before any traffic shift)
- [ ] Canary config checked in Git and validated: linear INF-4122 status = ready.
- [ ] Deployment artifact SHA verified and pinned in release manifest.
- [ ] Staging smoke matrix run: basic LLM generation, streaming, embeddings, tool-calling samples.
- [ ] Bench script executed: median and p95 token/sec within 10% of baseline.
- [ ] Observability hooks active: tracing, token-level cost metrics, KV cache hit rate instrumentation.
- [ ] Rate-limit backstop configured for safety-lane and windowing.
- [ ] Pager rotation and guardrails briefed; primary steward (Asha), secondary (Diego), SRE (Maya).
- [ ] Customer success pre-notice sent to top-10 accounts with SLA triggers.

Canary schedule (compact calendar)
- Window: 2026-06-12 18:00–20:00 PT (quiet window, low release collision).
- 18:00 PT: cohort A 5% for 15m -> validate telemetry.
- 18:15 PT: cohort A 20% for 30m -> validate.
- 18:45 PT: cohort B gradual ramp 20% -> 50% over 30m.
- 19:15 PT: pause 15m to inspect signal.
- 19:30 PT: ramp to 80% -> 100% between 19:30–19:45 PT if green.
- 19:45 PT: final commit and mark release-flag active.

Success criteria / gating signals (explicit)
- Latency: p95 request-to-first-byte <= 220ms for Hosted API and <= 350ms for Dedicated in worst-case region.
- Errors: 5xx rate < 0.5% of requests, user-facing API error rate < 0.2%.
- Cost: per-token unit cost delta <= 12% against projection.
- Quality: automated prompt-set eval regressions <= 2% on BLEU-like metric and prompt fidelity checks.
- Observability: KV cache hit-rate not falling > 10% vs baseline.

Telemetry / dashboards to watch (primary widgets)
- api.latency.p95 by region and model variant (hosted vs dedicated).
- infra.gpu.utilization by pod and pool (watch for hot spots).
- token_cost.per_request and token_cost.daily_rate.
- gen.error_rate and gen.exception.classifications (top-10 stack traces).
- kv_cache.hit_rate and kv_cache.evictions/min.
- Traces: sampling for slow requests (p99 > 1s).

Immediate mitigation & rollback criteria (if any of these happen -> trigger rollback)
- Any sustained p95 above threshold for > 10m configured alarm -> immediate pause and scale down new route weight.
- Error spike: 5xx rate > 1% for 5m -> rollback to previous manifest.
- Cost runaway: token_cost running 30% above projection for 2 consecutive 1h windows -> rollback and open postmortem.

Rollback steps (fast path)
1) Revert route config to pinned manifest (git rollback command in infra/runbooks).
2) If rollback fails: trigger hotpatch with global route override (ops emergency toggle).
3) Notify slack: #release-conservatory, escalate to SRE Lead and Product.
4) Keep rollback annotated in ticket INF-4122 and fill the stabilization log with timestamps and signals.

24h stabilization log (template for entries)
- Timestamp | Operator | Action | Signal observed | Notes
- Example: 2026-06-12T18:07Z | Asha | increased A to 20% | p95=172ms, 5xx=0.06% | green
- Keep concise entries; prefer timestamped bullets.

Post-rollout checks (first 24h priorities)
- Hourly snapshot of p95/p99 for first 6h, then 3h cadence until 24h.
- After 4h: run mini-eval suite against our canonical prompt set (regression detection).
- After 12h: verify cost runtimes vs projected model/quantization benefit.
- 24h: finalize release notes and switch status from draft->final in release manifest.

Compact release notes (draft - to be expanded for external changelog)
Title: model-v2 routing upgrade (conservatory) — staged rollout
Short blurb: We rolled out model-v2 with improved attention kernels and routing fallbacks to optimize for latency and cost. This release uses staged canaries and monitored rollouts; no action required for most customers.
Key changes:
- Routing: traffic-aware fallback to quantized model-compat variants when Dedicated pool saturates.
- Model: v2 improves long-sequence KV cache hits and reduces tail latency on typical prompts.
- Ops: improved telemetry for token-level costing.
Known limitations / notes:
- There is a small expected cost delta for heavy prefix workloads; we are monitoring and will publish guidance if we adjust batching defaults.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- Q: Should we pre-warm dedicated pools for accounts with heavy context length? (Maya to advise)
- Q: Do we enable auto-fallback based on predicted latency per-request or keep the deterministic routing policy? (product decision)
- TODO: add a short demo snippet for CS to explain fallbacks in customer-facing notes. (Jonah)
- TODO: check PR #1783 for an optional telemetry tag that isn't merged yet — defer if not in manifest.

Postmortem trigger policy (quick)
- Any rollback causes automatic postmortem with SLO review. Owner: release steward.

Appendix: quick commands & references (cheat)
- Rollback manifest: infra/deployments/releases/2026-06-12/manifest.yaml
- Canary toggle CLI: infra/cli route set-weight --route conservatory --weight 0.2 --cohort A
- Smoke run: scripts/release_smoke.sh --model v2 --sample 50
- Pager oncall: https://oncall.redwood/rota (primary: Asha, secondary: Diego)

Notes: rough, expect edits. This is intentionally compact — put details into the main runbook if we need extended debugging steps.

-- end of runpad --
